text_simplified: Among the guiding principles of upbringing is thanking Allah the Exalted for whatever sons and daughters He bestows, for a person does not know where goodness and benefit lie. Parents must beware of resembling the people of pre-Islamic ignorance whom Allah condemned for their displeasure when given glad tidings of a female child; and Abdullah ibn Umar (may Allah be pleased with them both) rebuked a man who wished for the death of his daughters, saying to him: "Is it you who provides for them?!"
